name: Whenlet
headline:
Remember when.
Get on with now.
description: Remember the last time you did something, from watering the plants to changing the sheets. See what is coming up without building a streak.
label: Last-done tracking
store_html: Available on theApp Store
features: Log a task in one tap, then edit or undo if needed. Leave the last date unknown rather than guessing.
Give one-off tasks a deadline or set a gentle interval for repeating tasks. Up Next shows what is due.
Search and correct your history, archive old tasks, or move your records with a backup. No push reminders.

name: Dimensions Planner
headline:
Every ratio.
Just right.
description: Calculate dimensions from an aspect ratio, preview fit and crop with your own image, and save your sizes by project.
label: Ratios & dimensions
store_html: Available on theApp Store
features: Enter a ratio and either dimension to calculate the other.
Import a photo or file to read its pixel dimensions and compare the whole-image Fit preview with centered Fill.
Save project presets and export or import portable backups that include the local picture previews.

name: Spin Sprout
headline:
Less deciding.
More doing.
description: Make a custom wheel, weight the choices, or run a group round that removes each pick. Get from deciding to doing.
label: Choices & group rounds
store_html: Available on theApp Store
features: Type or paste your choices and save a wheel for another day.
Adjust weights, see the odds, and use rounds to avoid repeats. Undo the last pick if needed.
Share a result or export a backup. The app supports 47 language and regional options.

name: Daycue
headline:
Your words.
Right on time.
description: Put your own words on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, and let the widget change with your schedule.
label: Scheduled widget cues
store_html: Available on theApp Store
features: Choose days and time windows for your cues, including windows that run past midnight.
Rotate through variations hourly or daily, or pin one cue to a widget all day.
Adjust color, alignment and text size. Daycue is a visual cue, not an alarm; iOS controls widget refresh timing.

name: Note Porch
headline:
A little note.
Always in view.
description: Pin a sticky note to a widget or schedule a different note for each part of the day. Take a selected note to your paired Apple Watch if you choose.
label: Notes on your screen
store_html: Available on theApp Store
features: Pin one note or build a daily plan with up to 16 times, including overnight.
Choose colors, alignment and text sizes for Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
Export a backup, preview an import, and add notes without replacing your current plan.

name: Pivotile
headline:
Make room.
Find your next move.
description: Clear rows and columns in Classic, where you earn turns, or play Flow, where a fresh piece arrives after every move.
label: Block puzzles with a twist
store_html: Available on theApp Store
features: In Classic, spend a pivot to turn a piece. In Flow, place one piece and immediately get the next.
Chain clears into combos, switch between Wood, Ocean and Neon themes, and compare scores on separate Game Center leaderboards.
Play three games a day free. A one-time Pivotile Full purchase unlocks unlimited games.

name: Tumblepatch
headline:
Piece it together.
Watch it come alive.
description: Put big pieces together and watch cars drive, rockets launch and dinosaurs stomp. A calm puzzle toy with 132 puzzles across nine groups.
label: Build & play puzzles
store_html: Available on theApp Store
features: Choose from 3 to 10 pieces, get a hint if needed, and pick up where you left off with Continue.
Play with the finished toy, move to the next puzzle, or turn off auto-advance. Choose from three gentle music tracks.
Try free puzzles in every group. One purchase unlocks the full collection; no ads or subscriptions.

name: Whisper Live
headline:
Say it.
See it in text.
description: Dictate into apps that accept the Whisper Live keyboard. Switch between a full keyboard and a single mic button, with speech processed on your device.
label: On-device voice keyboard
store_html: Available on theApp Store
features: Start, pause or resume with the mic close to your thumb; use voice-only mode for a larger button.
Use Apple speech recognition or the optional NVIDIA Parakeet model. Some models need a one-time download.
Say “new line,” “delete that,” or “change Monday to Tuesday” to edit as you speak.
Dictate up to 20 times a day for free. Pro adds unlimited dictation and custom templates.

Walk the site.
Keep the record.

Draw on a photo, preserve the original, and build a working PDF report to share.

Build a snowman.

One cable.

Aim, throw.
Haunt the manor.

One line at a time.
Make it yours.
